subject: mth
title: (R)MTH.------AF.DY.
description: Diagram in CMBA-10. (R)MTH (the reality of methodology) is crossed with AFL-DY (affinity dynamics): the question is what *real* methodology — not just the concept — looks like when crossed with the affinity dynamics of post-Coleman/Taylor black creativity. Note the title abbreviates as AF.DY, but no AF.DY label appears in the drawing: the arrowed label is drawn (c)MTH, and its main line runs to SOC-RT-DEVF (social reality diversification). MTH branches to VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) → IF-ST-DY (infra-structure dynamics), and to EXT-FT (extended functionalism). EXT-FT branches to MT-DEVF (multiple diversification) → RT-DY (reality dynamics), and to ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism) → PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) → IST-PT (isolated particulars) → LANG-DY (language dynamics).
